meta.title: Mustafti — Clarifies your question, never issues fatwas
meta.description: Mustafti answers your questions about Islam in any language from trusted Islamic sources, and carries your personal question to qualified scholars. It never issues religious rulings.

disclosure.text: Mustafti is an AI tool, not a mufti or a preacher. It answers from trusted sources only.

footer.joinExpertHint: A mufti, preacher or new-Muslim mentor? Help us route questions to the right people.
footer.challenge: An entry in the AI for Islamic Content Challenge 2026.
footer.tagline: Clarifies your question. Never issues fatwas.
footer.sourceNote: Primary source: the association's official Islamic content server.

s1.title: Your question

s2.title: We clarify
s2.body: If it's about your own situation, we ask a few calm questions until the picture is complete.

s3.title: A trusted source, or a scholar
s3.body: General questions get quoted text with its link. Personal cases reach a verified scholar as an anonymous file.

case.typeHint: Pick an answer or type it in the box below.
case.drafting: Organising your case file and removing anything that identifies you…
case.cancelled: Clarification cancelled; nothing was saved. You can start again any time, or ask a general question.
case.error: That did not work right now. Please try again.
case.errorEmail: The email address is not valid. Correct it or leave it empty.
case.reviewLead: Review your case file before sending, and edit it freely with “Edit”. We removed anything that might identify you and put [محذوف] (removed) in its place, and we did not ask for your name.
case.question: Your question
case.emailHint: Used only to notify you of the answer; the specialist does not see it.
case.routeMufti: The file will go to a qualified mufti.

case.sentLead: Save this secret link: it lets you follow your file and the specialist's answer, and anyone who has it can see the file. We will not show it again except in this browser.
case.sentLinked: It is linked to your account, so you will also find it in “My questions and files”.
case.notSentYet: Nothing has been sent yet. Your file is saved only after you press “I agree, send”.

caseFile.notFoundLead: We could not find a file for this link. Check that you copied it completely.
caseFile.waiting: No answer yet. You will find it here when it arrives, God willing.
caseFile.privacy: This link is secret: share it only with someone you trust.
caseFile.fileTitle: The case file as you sent it
caseFile.meEmpty: No files yet. Ask about your situation in the chat, and Mustafti will help you send it to a specialist.
caseFile.meHint: Each file's secret link is shown once when you send it; here you see your files' status and the specialist's answer.

join.name: Name as shown to reviewers
join.specialtyHint: e.g. Hanafi fiqh, ʿaqidah, teaching new Muslims
join.traditional: I studied traditionally (with scholars, without a formal degree)

join.tazkiyatHint: The scholar who recommends you, and how the reviewer can contact them.
join.needOne: Attach at least one certificate, or add a recommendation.
join.needTazkiya: If you studied traditionally, add at least one recommendation.

pledgeItems.p1: The information and documents I provided are true.
pledgeItems.p2: I answer only with knowledge, and say “I don’t know” when I don’t.
pledgeItems.p3: I respect the asker’s privacy: I will not try to identify them or share anything from their file.
pledgeItems.p4: My answer reaches the asker as I wrote it, with a machine translation for reference if they are not Arabic speakers.

join.pledge: I declare and pledge the above
